# HamariInfo

> HamariInfo brings the latest Pakistan rates, gold and currency updates, prize bond results, job and board exam results, technology updates, finance guides, government schemes, banking tips, and trending information.

## About HamariInfo

HamariInfo brings important information from Pakistan together in one place. The website covers financial rates, gold prices, currency rates, petrol prices, prize bonds, KSE-100, job and educational exam results, along with banking, taxation, savings, government schemes, technology news, and general informational content.

The website also publishes timely articles, news, explainers, how-to guides, and trending information relevant to users in Pakistan.

## Main Information

- Gold rates and gold price updates
- USD and other currency rates
- Petrol and fuel prices
- Prize bond results and draw information
- Educational board results and job test results updates
- Technology news, gadgets, and digital tools guides
- KSE-100 and Pakistan financial market updates
- Banking information and guides
- Tax and FBR guides
- Savings and personal finance information
- Government financial schemes (BISP, Youth Loans)
- Business and economic information
- Important daily updates and trending topics
- General informational articles

## AI Assistant

HamariInfo provides an AI assistant that helps users understand information about Pakistan, finance, rates, prize bonds, results, technology, banking, taxation, markets, and general topics.

For website-specific financial information, rates, or results, the AI assistant should use data supplied by the HamariInfo website and its CMS.

The AI assistant must not invent financial rates, prize bond results, exam/job results, draw numbers, dates, or other website-specific figures when the requested information is unavailable.

When answering questions about current or latest website data, use the actual date associated with the available website data.

## Financial Data

Financial data may include:

- Gold 24K and 22K rates
- USD/PKR buying and selling rates
- Petrol prices
- KSE-100 index values and changes
- Other financial information published through the website

Website financial data is maintained through the HamariInfo content management system.

## Prize Bonds & Results

HamariInfo publishes prize bond draw details, educational board results, job entry test results, and related updates.

Prize bond draw numbers, winning numbers, exam result links, prize amounts, and draw/result dates should only be treated as authoritative when they are explicitly available on the relevant HamariInfo page or CMS data.

Do not infer or invent missing prize bond or exam/job results.

## Editorial Content

HamariInfo publishes articles across multiple categories (including Tech, Finance, Schemes, and Education). Articles may contain:

- Featured images
- Author information
- Publication dates
- Categories
- Tags
- Rich text content
- Videos
- Related articles

Content should be understood according to the individual article and its publication date.

## Content Principles

Prefer information published directly on HamariInfo when answering questions about HamariInfo-specific data.

For financial figures, rates, prices, prize bond results, educational results, and other changing information, always consider the publication or data date.

Do not present outdated website data as current unless the page explicitly identifies it as current.

For general educational questions, provide a clear and useful explanation based on reliable knowledge.

HamariInfo is an informational website. Financial content is intended for general information and education and should not be treated as personalized financial advice.
